sections.label: NTUC Enterprise Kopitiam acquisition review
sections.summary: CCCS was notified on 28 September 2018 of NTUC Enterprise's proposed acquisition of Kopitiam and is assessing it, with NTUC Enterprise committed not to proceed until CCCS decides.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng
sentences.text: The Competition and Consumer Commission of Singapore (CCCS) has been notified of the National Trades Union Congress (NTUC) Enterprise's proposed acquisition of Kopitiam and its subsidiaries on 28 September 2018 and is currently assessing the transaction.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng
sentences.text: NTUC Enterprise has committed not to proceed with the merger until CCCS has issued its decision.

sections.label: HDB eating house and hawker plans
sections.summary: HDB reviewed tender mechanisms to consider factors such as affordability, and MND and MEWR announced plans to build more HDB eating houses and hawker centres.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng
sentences.text: For example, the Housing and Development Board (HDB) has reviewed tender mechanisms to consider factors, such as affordability, when tendering eating houses.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng
sentences.text: The Ministry of National Development (MND) and the Ministry of the Environment and Water Resources (MEWR) have also announced plans to build more HDB eating houses and hawker centres in future.

sections.label: Kopitiam empty coffee shop bid
sections.summary: Of six stalls, only one stall and one drinks stall were open, and the passage asks why Kopitiam bid for that coffee shop and left it empty for two to three years.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Out of six stalls, only one stall was open and one drinks stall.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: So, why did Kopitiam bid for that coffee shop and leave it empty for the last two, three years?
